{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
filtered_df = sales_df[(sales_df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Check the number of such customers
count_new_paid_search = len(filtered_df)

# Check how many of them converted
converted_count = filtered_df['converted'].sum()

# Compute the fraction
fraction_converted = converted_count / count_new_paid_search

# Print the results
count_new_paid_search, converted_count, fraction_converted"}
